title: Iron law of ML systems: product form
caption: Dimensional cancellation over the D-A-M axes: the first two factors multiply to total operations $O$.

symbols.name: total time
symbols.meaning: wall-clock time for the task, in seconds

symbols.name: samples per task
symbols.meaning: how many inputs must pass through: the Data factor

symbols.name: work per sample
symbols.meaning: operations the model spends on each input: the Algorithm factor

symbols.name: seconds per FLOP
symbols.meaning: what each operation costs on this machine: the Machine factor

title: Iron law of ML systems: sequential bound
caption: Total latency is the *sum* of data movement, compute, and overheads when the stages run in series.

symbols.name: sequential time
symbols.meaning: wall-clock time when no stage overlaps another

symbols.name: memory time
symbols.meaning: moving all required bytes at effective bandwidth: D_vol / BW

symbols.name: compute time
symbols.meaning: executing all operations at achieved rate: O / (R_peak * eta_hw)

symbols.name: fixed overhead
symbols.meaning: latency that survives at zero work: kernel launches, network RTTs, setup

title: Iron law: overlapped lower bound
caption: Perfect prefetch/compute overlap can hide the smaller of the two dominant terms, but never both, and never the overhead.

symbols.name: overlapped time
symbols.meaning: fastest achievable time when movement and compute fully overlap

symbols.name: binding term
symbols.meaning: whichever stage is slower sets the floor; the other hides inside it

symbols.name: fixed overhead
symbols.meaning: latency that survives at zero work: kernel launches, network RTTs, setup

title: Silent degradation under drift
caption: Accuracy decays roughly in proportion to divergence $D$ between the serving-time distribution $P_t$ and the training-time distribution $P_0$, while every infra metric stays green.

symbols.name: accuracy at time t
symbols.meaning: quality on live traffic now, the thing nobody is measuring

symbols.name: baseline accuracy
symbols.meaning: quality at deployment, measured on the eval set

symbols.name: drift sensitivity
symbols.meaning: how fast accuracy falls per unit of divergence; fitted per model

symbols.name: distribution divergence
symbols.meaning: distance between what the model sees now and what it was trained/evaluated on

title: Energy counterpart of the iron law
caption: The same two work terms priced in joules instead of seconds. A DRAM byte costs ~145x an FP16 FLOP, so movement dominates.

symbols.name: total energy
symbols.meaning: joules spent running the task

symbols.name: data volume
symbols.meaning: bytes moved: weights, activations, inputs

symbols.name: energy per byte
symbols.meaning: cost of moving one byte; ~145x an FP16 FLOP for DRAM

symbols.name: operations
symbols.meaning: total FLOPs executed

symbols.name: energy per operation
symbols.meaning: cost of one FLOP; shrinks with precision (INT8 much cheaper)

title: Return on compute
caption: Accuracy gained per unit of additional compute. The chapter's efficiency lens: spending compute on the wrong term buys nothing.

symbols.name: return on compute
symbols.meaning: quality bought per unit of compute spent; the efficiency question

symbols.name: quality gained
symbols.meaning: improvement on the metric you actually care about

symbols.name: compute spent
symbols.meaning: extra FLOPs, memory, or wall-clock budget you paid
